genealogy.notes: Korean belongs to the small Koreanic family: Korean and the Jeju language (Jejueo) are its only members, and some scholars call Korean an isolate. Jejueo has no tag in the app registry, so related_language_tags is empty. The old idea that Korean is related to Japanese, Mongolic and Turkic (the "Altaic" hypothesis) is not accepted by most linguists; Korean shares grammar habits with Japanese and a large Chinese-derived vocabulary, but that is not shown to be family relationship. Broad orientation metadata only.
